name: listInterfaces
description: Gets a paginated, filtered, and sorted list of interfaces. Corresponds to GET /api/stations/v1/interfaces. Requires `stations:read` scope. [READ-ONLY]

sort.description: Comma-separated sort fields: id, name, lastModified.at, created.at. Prefix with - for descending.

filter.description: Only interfaces at one station: stationId eq '<id>' (or eq null for unassigned). Only the eq operator is supported.

archived.description: List archived items instead of active ones.
